CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Remove the need for rules

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

3. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Songs.

4. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Brown, pink, and gold
